evidence.limitations: Fixed native request family; not arbitrary model/mode support.
Recognized QA events only; file blocks do not imply material CRUD.
Local owner/account/session binding; not cross-account upstream history.
Refresh needs valid saved credentials; never a promise of permanent login.
Human QR flow and browser capture; not a standalone QR wire API.
Target membership check; does not enumerate every private library.
Intent suffix and observed counts; no hard guarantee that every request searches.
Independent OpenAPI credentials and ID namespace; not the web account pool.
Two SDK STDIO MCP questions in one conversation, scoped to that historical machine/profile. Does not prove all accounts or fresh native MCP asks.
Synthetic material mapping; exact upstream IDs are required. Not merged or deployed.
Separate OpenAPI identity and verified bindings required. Real reading pending; PDF disabled.
Anonymous static declarations. Prefixes and suffixes are not automatically paired; no business request executed.
